scripts.//vercel-build: Vercel prefers this over `build`. Migrations and RLS run HERE, not in `build`, because CI builds without a database and must stay that way. The documented deploy order was `git push` (which auto-deploys) and THEN `npm run db:deploy` from a laptop — i.e. it shipped code ahead of its own schema. This makes that impossible: the deploy fails rather than serving a stale schema. rls.sql is idempotent and derives tenant tables from the catalog, so it is safe on every build and picks up new tables automatically.
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:rls && next build
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv-run() { set -a; . ./.env; set +a; }; dotenv-run; DATABASE_URL="$ADMIN_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:rls && npm run db:verify-rls
scripts.db:rls: DATABASE_URL="$ADMIN_DATABASE_URL" prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/rls.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma
